text:
Ah, Lady Fortune! In vain
you show yourself disdainful. Your favors
I shall win with courageous spirit,
like all brave fighters.

In the fierce contest you will fall subdued;
I forge the yoke to which you’ll be harnessed.
But seeing you disarmed at my feet,
I feel a mortal wound within my heart.

Red blood wells up in a river,
and the sweet breath of life…
when at last the triumph I desired is mine,
I feel my strength give way, and I am dying.

translation.title: Ah, Lady Fortune, In Vain
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
